title: Create debounced search hook and URL parameter management
description: Implement a custom useDebounce hook for search input optimization and create utilities for managing filter state through URL search parameters
details: Create a custom useDebounce hook in hooks/use-debounce.ts that delays API calls until user stops typing (300ms delay). Implement URL parameter management utilities using Next.js useSearchParams, useRouter, and usePathname hooks to synchronize filter state with URL. This includes functions to parse current filters from URL, update URL with new filter values, and clear all filters. The URL should serve as the single source of truth for filter state to enable shareable links and browser history navigation.
test_strategy: Unit tests for useDebounce hook to verify delay behavior and cleanup. Integration tests for URL parameter utilities to ensure correct parsing and updating of search parameters. Test browser back/forward navigation with filter states.

title: Build enhanced filter row component with multi-select capabilities
description: Create or enhance the filter row component with advanced filtering options including multi-select dropdowns, date range picker, and improved search input
details: Develop components/dashboard/filter-row.tsx with shadcn/ui components: DropdownMenu with DropdownMenuCheckboxItem for multi-select status/category filters, Popover with Calendar component for date range selection, and enhanced Input component for search. Implement responsive design that works on mobile devices. Include clear filters functionality and visual indicators for active filters. Use the debounced search hook and URL parameter management from task 1. Ensure all components are accessible with proper ARIA attributes and keyboard navigation.
test_strategy: Component tests using React Testing Library to verify filter interactions, multi-select behavior, date range selection, and clear filters functionality. Accessibility tests to ensure keyboard navigation and screen reader compatibility.

title: Update data fetching logic to handle advanced filter parameters
description: Modify the backend data fetching logic to parse and apply the new filter parameters in database queries using Drizzle ORM
details: Update the API route or server action responsible for fetching dashboard data to handle the new filter parameters from URL search params. Implement dynamic Drizzle ORM query construction with appropriate where clauses for multi-select filters, date range filtering, and text search. Add proper orderBy clauses for sorting. Ensure queries are optimized for performance and handle edge cases like empty filters or invalid date ranges. Include proper error handling and validation for filter parameters.
test_strategy: Unit tests for query construction logic with various filter combinations. Integration tests to verify correct data filtering and sorting. Performance tests to ensure queries remain efficient with multiple filters applied.

title: Integrate enhanced filters with dashboard page and data display
description: Connect the enhanced filter row component with the dashboard page and ensure proper data flow between filters and data display components
details: Update app/dashboard/page.tsx to integrate the new filter row component and connect it with the data fetching logic. Ensure the filter state from URL parameters is properly passed to both the filter component and data fetching functions. Implement loading states during filter operations and error handling for failed filter requests. Add visual feedback for active filters and ensure the data display components (tables, charts) properly reflect the filtered results. Test the complete user flow from filter selection to data display update.
test_strategy: End-to-end tests covering the complete filter workflow from user interaction to data display. Integration tests to verify proper communication between filter components and data fetching. User experience testing to ensure smooth interactions and appropriate loading states.
